headline: College student stabbed on moving train in Banani
summary: Tofayel Islam, a 20-year-old student, was attacked by muggers who stabbed him in the back during a struggle for his money and phone.
details: A 20-year-old college student, Tofayel Islam, was injured after being stabbed by muggers on a moving train in the Banani area of Dhaka.
The incident occurred on Saturday around 2:45 PM. Tofayel, a second-year HSC student at Alhaj Shah Alam Degree College in Brahmanbaria, was traveling from Kamalapur Railway Station to his hometown.
According to his cousin, Shiuli Akter, four to five youths surrounded Tofayel on the train and attempted to steal his money and mobile phone.
During the struggle, the attackers stabbed Tofayel in the back before fleeing the train at the Cantonment crossing area without taking any belongings.
Tofayel was first rescued by a pedestrian and taken to Kurmitola General Hospital, then transferred to Dhaka Medical College Hospital for advanced treatment.
Inspector Mo. Faruk, in-charge of the police camp at Dhaka Medical College Hospital, confirmed that the injured student is currently receiving treatment in the emergency department.

headline_marked: Armed robbers [[attack AC Land officer and 5 others]] in Narayanganj
headline: Armed robbers attack AC Land officer and 5 others in Narayanganj
summary: The victims were hacked with sharp weapons during a late-night raid in Araihazar. Robbers also looted 2.7 lakh BDT and gold ornaments from a nearby house.
details: A group of 10 to 12 armed robbers attacked several people, including Sakib Hasan Khan, the Assistant Commissioner (Land) of Muradnagar, Comilla, in Araihazar, Narayanganj.
The incident occurred around 1 AM on Friday night in the Dhondi and Rainadi-Atadi areas of Haijadi Union.
Sakib Hasan Khan was visiting his home on leave. He and several friends were sitting by the roadside due to a power outage when the robbers attacked them with sharp weapons.
The attackers hacked Sakib Hasan Khan, Mukul (38), Rajib (32), Rubel (36), Faruk (32), and Dalia (33), leaving them seriously injured.
The victims were first taken to the Araihazar Upazila Health Complex and later moved to Dhaka for advanced treatment. Sakib Hasan Khan has since been discharged from Dhaka Medical College Hospital.
In a separate incident the same night, robbers are alleged to have looted 2.7 lakh BDT in cash and approximately 14 bhori of gold ornaments from a nearby house.
Araihazar Police Station OC Mo. Sobzel Hossain confirmed the visit to the scene and stated that nothing was stolen from the victims during the attack on the AC Land officer.
The Araihazar Upazila Nirbahi Officer (UNO) Asadur Rahman stated that the robbers hacked anyone they encountered while fleeing. Police are currently working to arrest the suspects.
